Growing up in Toronto I have always had an interest in the environment, enhanced by both my educational and recreational pursuits. I am an avid reader and enjoy cross country mountain biking, hoping one day to ride a variety of trails across the world.

My career objective is to utilize the knowledge learnt from my Bachelor's, Certificate and Master's programs as well as the experience gained working in a dynamic office environment to build my skills and qualifications with related work in the geological and geomatics industries, providing a positive impact on an organization as well as on resource and environmental management.
